t: You're looking at St Edmund, King and Martyr, an Anglican church on Lombard Street. It is named for Edmund, who was king of East Anglia from about 855 until his death. Sir Christopher Wren designed the building, one of the 52 City churches he rebuilt after the Great Fire. From 2001 it housed the London Centre for Spirituality, later renamed the London Centre for Spiritual Direction, though it remains a consecrated church. Since 2019, Imprint Church has held regular worship inside. Jeremiah Milles, Dean of Exeter and President of the Society of Antiquaries, is buried here.
